what_constrained: Release facts differ from local beta assets; launch content must follow public availability.
what_worked: Plain static source, allowlisted packaging, real imagery, browser QA plus independent source review.
what_differently: Check image aspect ratios at first desktop render before collecting responsive evidence.

what_constrained: Release-batch evidence was mistaken for a complete developer inventory.
what_worked: Terminal paginated catalog snapshot, ID-based completeness gate, native preview validation, unchanged canonical spec copies.
what_differently: Use the current developer catalog as inventory source at the beginning; release evidence establishes provenance, not completeness.

what_constrained: Manual browser inventory and Render public-repository deployments prevented unattended updates.
what_worked: Public paginated server-data discovery, staged image validation, content fingerprints, and commit-pinned hooks; two real cloud runs verified deploy and no-op behavior.
what_differently: Validate full image decoding and fresh-checkout test assumptions before enabling cloud workflows.

what_constrained: Two local-only apps had different runtime needs; safe public input and small-screen controls were missing.
what_worked: Browser-native Retro plus an attested Lexical bundle fit existing Render hosting. Fresh review caught reserved-word crashes; actual downloads proved PNG export.
what_differently: Use directly accessible upload fixtures; symlinked scratch fixtures stalled browser file reads. Start the public sample and mobile control audit early.

what_constrained: Reading meaning had to remain connected to an expressive 3D scene without sending visitor text to a server.
what_worked: One canonical occurrence model, complete SVG fallback, real downloaded-file roundtrips, and independent source verification.
what_differently: Establish shared color and token identity before building separate visualization panels.
